EMPLOYMENT TRIBUNALS





Claimant:
Marcus Foster




Respondent: Coleg Ceredigion (R1)


Coleg Sir Gar (R2)


University of Wales Trinity Saint David (R3)


HELD AT:

Mold
on: 3rd February 2026


BEFORE:
Employment Judge T. Vincent Ryan



REPRESENTATION:

For the Claimant: Litigant in person

For the Respondents: Mr J Burke, Solicitor for R1 &2 (and Ms Rebecca Jones,
Observer)



Mr S Liberazadzki, Counsel for R3




JUDGMENT

The judgment of the Tribunal is:

1. University of Wales Trinity Saint David (R3) is dismissed as a party to these
proceedings;

2. The Claimant was not continuously employed for a period of two years ending
with the effective date of termination, and his claim of "ordinary" Unfair
Dismissal (ostensibly by reason of Redundancy), is dismissed (s.108 (1)
Employment Rights Act 1996);

3. This judgment does not affect the Claimant's extant claims against R1 and R2
of Automatic Unfair Dismissal and Detriment (Public Interest Disclosure) and
Wrongful Dismissal.

Approved by Employment Judge T V Ryan
Date: 03.02.26

23 February 2026





Katie Dickson
